title: 琐窗寒·寒食
title_en: Suo Chuang Han: The Cold Food Festival
author: 周邦彦

text_note.zh: 词牌底本写作“锁窗寒”，又注“琐寒窗”；通行本多写作“琐窗寒”。琐窗，是刻着连环花纹的窗子。通行本题作“寒食”。
text_note.en: Our source writes the tune name with a different first character and lists another variant. Common editions write it Suo Chuang Han, where suǒ chuāng means a window carved with linked patterns. Common editions add the title "The Cold Food Festival".

readings.zh: “少年”是年轻的时候，“少”读 shào。
readings.en: "Shào nián" means one's young days, so the character is read shào.

readings.zh: “暝宿”是天黑后住宿，“宿”读 sù。
readings.en: "Míng sù" means stopping for the night after dark, so the character is read sù.

readings.zh: “禁城”指皇宫所在的京城，“禁”读 jìn。
readings.en: "Jìn chéng" means the capital where the palace stands, so the character is read jìn.

glosses.zh: 暗柳：枝叶茂密、颜色深暗的柳树。
glosses.en: àn liǔ: willows so thick with leaves that they look dark.

glosses.zh: 伫立：长时间站着不动。
glosses.en: zhù lì: to stand still for a long time.

glosses.zh: 朱户：红漆的门。
glosses.en: zhū hù: a red-painted door.

glosses.zh: 桐花：泡桐树开的花，大约在清明前后开放。
glosses.en: tóng huā: paulownia blossoms, which open around the Qingming season.

glosses.zh: 静锁一庭愁雨：静静的院子好像被叫人发愁的雨锁住了。
glosses.en: jìng suǒ yī tíng chóu yǔ: the quiet courtyard seems locked in by sad rain.

glosses.zh: 空阶：没有人的台阶。
glosses.en: kōng jiē: empty steps.

glosses.zh: 夜阑：夜深了。
glosses.en: yè lán: late in the night.

glosses.zh: 剪烛西窗：在西窗下剪烛芯、长谈到深夜。唐代李商隐有“何当共剪西窗烛”的诗句。古时蜡烛点久了要剪去烧焦的烛芯，灯才亮。
glosses.en: jiǎn zhú xī chuāng: trimming the candle by the west window and talking late into the night. It comes from a line by the Tang poet Li Shangyin. Old candles had to have their burnt wicks trimmed to keep burning bright.

glosses.zh: 楚江暝宿：天黑后停宿在楚地的江边。楚，指长江中游一带。
glosses.en: chǔ jiāng míng sù: stopping for the night on a river in the old land of Chu, along the middle Yangtze.

glosses.zh: 风灯零乱：船上的灯在风里摇来摇去。
glosses.en: fēng dēng líng luàn: the boat lamps swaying every which way in the wind.

glosses.zh: 羁旅：在外地漂泊做客。
glosses.en: jī lǚ: being a traveler far from home.

glosses.zh: 迟暮：年纪大了。
glosses.en: chí mù: getting old, in the evening of one's life.

glosses.zh: 店舍无烟：店铺人家都不生火。寒食节有禁火的风俗。
glosses.en: diàn shè wú yān: no smoke from shops or homes, because of the custom of lighting no fires at the Cold Food Festival.

glosses.zh: 百五：冬至后第一百零五天，就是寒食节，在清明前一两天。
glosses.en: bǎi wǔ: the hundred-and-fifth day after the winter solstice. That is the Cold Food Festival, a day or two before Qingming.

glosses.zh: 旗亭：挂着酒旗的酒楼。
glosses.en: qí tíng: a wine shop with a flag hung outside.

glosses.zh: 高阳俦侣：一起喝酒的朋友。秦汉之际的郦食其自称“高阳酒徒”，后来“高阳”就指爱喝酒的人。俦侣，伙伴。
glosses.en: gāo yáng chóu lǚ: drinking companions. Li Yiji, a man of the Qin and Han era, called himself the wine lover of Gaoyang. After that, Gaoyang stood for people who love to drink.

glosses.zh: 自春：自顾自地开花，迎来春天。
glosses.en: zì chūn: blossoming into spring on their own, with no one to watch.

glosses.zh: 小唇秀靥：小小的嘴唇，好看的酒窝。一说指桃李花像美人的唇和笑脸；一说指留在家里的心上人。
glosses.en: xiǎo chún xiù yè: small lips and pretty dimples. One reading says the peach and plum blossoms look like a lovely face. Another says it means the beloved left at home.

glosses.zh: 残英：还没落尽的花。英，花。
glosses.en: cán yīng: the last flowers still on the branch. Yīng means a flower.

glosses.zh: 尊俎：酒杯和摆肉的器具，这里指酒菜。
glosses.en: zūn zǔ: a wine vessel and a meat stand, that is, wine and food.

translation.en: In the dark willows, crows are crying.

translation.zh: 我穿着单衣久久地站着，
translation.en: In thin clothes I stand there a long time,

translation.zh: 对着小小的帘子和红色的门。
translation.en: by a small curtain and a red door.
Half an acre of paulownia is in bloom,

translation.zh: 静静的院子被愁人的雨锁住了。
translation.en: and a quiet courtyard is locked in sad rain.
It sprinkles on the empty steps,
and late at night it still has not stopped.

translation.zh: 真想有老朋友在西窗下剪着烛芯，和我长谈。
translation.en: How I wish an old friend were here to trim the candle with me and talk by the west window.

translation.zh: 这情景，就像当年在楚地江边停船过夜，
translation.en: It is just like those nights I stopped on the rivers of Chu,
the lamps swaying in the wind,

translation.zh: 那是我年轻时在外漂泊的日子。
translation.en: in the days when I wandered as a young man.
Now I am old.
And as for places to enjoy myself:

translation.zh: 正赶上店铺人家都不生火，
translation.en: right now no smoke rises from shops or homes,
for it is the Cold Food Festival in the capital.
At the wine shop I call for wine,

translation.zh: 都交给那些爱喝酒的朋友吧。
translation.en: and leave it all to my drinking friends.
I think of the east garden at home,

translation.zh: 桃花李花自己开着，迎来春天，
translation.en: where the peach and plum blossoms greet the spring by themselves.

translation.zh: 那小小的嘴唇、好看的酒窝，现在还在吗？
translation.en: Those small lips and pretty dimples, are they still there?
When I go home,
surely some last flowers will remain,

translation.zh: 等着我这位客人带着酒菜来赏。
translation.en: waiting for this guest to come with wine and food.

background.zh: 这首词写寒食节。寒食在清明前一两天，古人这几天不生火，只吃冷的食物。词里的“禁城”指京城，可见周邦彦写这首词时正在京城做客，离家很远。这首词具体写于哪一年，说法不一。寒食节下着雨，他一个人站在院子里，想起年轻时的漂泊，也想起家乡东园的花。
background.en: This lyric is about the Cold Food Festival. It falls a day or two before Qingming. For those days people lit no fires and ate only cold food. The lyric mentions the capital, so Zhou Bangyan was staying there as a guest, far from home. Scholars differ on the exact year. On a rainy Cold Food day he stands alone in a courtyard. He remembers wandering as a young man, and thinks of the flowers in the east garden at home.

author_note.zh: 周邦彦（1056—1121），字美成，号清真居士，钱塘（今浙江杭州）人，北宋著名词人。他精通音乐，曾主管朝廷的音乐机构大晟府，创作了不少新的曲调。他的词用字讲究，结构精巧，后人称他是词中的大家。
author_note.en: Zhou Bangyan (1056–1121), courtesy name Meicheng, pen name Qingzhen Jushi, came from Qiantang (today's Hangzhou). He was a famous Northern Song lyric poet. He knew music deeply, once ran the court's music office, the Dasheng Bureau, and created many new tunes. His lyrics are carefully worded and cleverly built, and later readers saw him as a master of the form.

appreciation.zh: 上片写寒食节的雨夜。柳色深暗，乌鸦啼叫，诗人穿着单衣站在门前；桐花开了半亩，雨却把整个院子锁住了。雨一直下到深夜，他多希望有老朋友在西窗下陪他剪烛长谈。这雨声和灯影，又让他想起年轻时在楚江边停船过夜的情景。一个人在外的孤单，从年轻到年老都没变。下片写眼前和将来：如今老了，正赶上寒食，京城家家不生火，他把酒都让给朋友喝，自己没了兴致。心思飞回家乡，想到东园的桃李自开自落，不知心上人还在不在。最后他安慰自己：回去时总还有残花等着。这一点小小的希望，让整首词在愁里带着一点暖。
appreciation.en: The first stanza shows a rainy night at the Cold Food Festival. The willows are dark, crows cry, and the poet stands at the door in thin clothes. Half an acre of paulownia is in bloom, but the rain locks up the whole courtyard. The rain goes on late into the night, and he longs for an old friend to trim the candle and talk with him by the west window. The sound of rain and the lamplight remind him of nights on the rivers of Chu when he was young. Being alone far from home has not changed from youth to old age. The second stanza turns to now and to the future. He is old, it is the Cold Food Festival, and no fires burn in the capital. He leaves the wine to his friends, having lost the mood himself. His thoughts fly home. Peach and plum blossoms open and fall in the east garden with no one to see, and he wonders whether his beloved is still there. In the end he comforts himself: when he returns, some last flowers will be waiting. That small hope adds a little warmth to all the sadness.
